Select the molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Source the data from the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1122107. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then filter compound_records where doc_id corresponds to the specified document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve SMILES. Sort the results by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
